title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.20
body_markdown:
*released October 14th, 2025*

### What's New in this release

* Updated MinGit to v2.50.1 to address an issue where users with repositories located on ReFS volumes and Windows Server 2022 couldn't perform Git operations with VS IDE.

### Developer Community

* [Git operations fail when repository is located on a ReFS volume](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Git-operations-fail-when-repository-is-l/10934496)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2025-55240**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-55240) Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability - Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Gulpfile
* [**CVE-2025-55315**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-55315) .NET Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability - âHTTP Request Smuggling vulnerability due to incorrect parsing of chunk extension
* [**CVE-2025-55248**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-55248) .NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability - SmtpClient may connect without TLS even if UseSsl is true
